title: "That Guy"'s Scheme
description: The fallen meteorites have turned Mondstadt upside down, inside and out. But it seems that the mysterious Vile is looking for people to help her out with a little something...

dialogs.text: Oh my, you're here at last. I've been waiting.
Whatever for?
Come on, don't be so cold. I have something very important to ask of you.
I'm sure you've seen those meteorites. Though none of them landed inside the city of Mondstadt, the whole place is in an uproar all the same.
And where there's muddied water, there will be fish that don't belong trying to slip in unnoticed.
You mean the Treasure Hoarders.
Aha, aren't you keen? That's an experienced adventurer for you.
Though the Knights are on high alert, there's bound to be some gaps in their defenses, what with having to send help to the areas around the city and all.
Those money-grubbing Treasure Hoarders have surely made plans to slip through those gaps and "make a killing," as they say.
So, where do I fit in?
Oh my, what a straightforward answer.
It seems like the contingency plan that gentleman gave me was unnecessary after all.
Well, simply put, that gentleman has apprehended the Treasure Hoarders who were scouting us out previously.
According to them, there are three bands of these bandits looking to slip in during the chaos.
So we'll play along, and help them create the ideal opening...
And where do I come in?
What you have to do is simple.

To ensure that not everyone would be caught, the Treasure Hoarder scouts didn't report back directly. Instead, they would leave the intel they'd gathered in letters that would then be left in specially designated locations.
To avoid any other problems from occurring, they also sent three scouts, who would then send the intelligence they gathered to three different locations.
I doubt they expected that all three would be caught by that gentleman...
The other Treasure Hoarders will only begin to plan their next move after receiving this intelligence, all the better to choose the best point of entry.
But we'll spare them the trouble this time. That gentleman has already made most detailed plans for them.
Take these three letters with you, and place them at the locations designated by the Treasure Hoarders.
Once that's done, come back and report to me. As for what comes next... Let's discuss that later, shall we?
Can their word be trusted?
Haha, you're very cautious, aren't you? Don't worry, the Treasure Hoarders are quite the spineless lot.
They are, in the end, just a bunch of small-timers who're in it for the money.
"There's Mora in it for you if you work with us, but if you try anything funny..."
They were quite quick to cooperate once we reached this amicable understanding.
The Knights can handle it.
Haha, I thought you might say that.
Don't you worry about a thing, that gentleman has prepared quite the budget this time around. You stand to be well-compensated.
And if you should pick anything up while going about this business, it's yours to keep.
What's more, this task requires your unique touch.
You mean the hilichurls?
Haha, of course not. How would they even blend in?
I'm sure the knights would be all too ready for them if they even tried getting close to the walls.
I'm talking about the Treasure Hoarders.
You haven't set off yet? Ah, yes... You must have some other questions, then?
Who's this gentleman, anyway?
Hmm. That gentleman is an old acquaintance of yours, really. He says that you even fought side by side for a time.
I can't give you his name, though. That would be on my head for sure.
Why don't we just bring all those Treasure Hoarders in directly?
You mean to say that even if we do defeat the three bands of Treasure Hoarders lured in by our messages, the rest will simply flee after hearing the news, yes?
Well, that's true, but this is precisely the intention. That gentleman doesn't wish to catch them all, but to send them a little shock.
Under the present circumstances, the Knights cannot spare the people to undertake a large manhunt.
In any case, the falling meteorites are the top priority at present.
As for Treasure Hoarders, they just need to be... convinced to stop making trouble for now.

dialogs.text: Have you planted the letters?
Indeed.
That will do. I trust that the Treasure Hunters will make their plans based on the intelligence contained within those letters.
And that "ideal moment" should be somewhere between nightfall and dawn.
As for the "ideal entry point..." Well, there can only be one, yes? Come, I'll mark it out on your map.
Well, that should do it. All we need to do now is wait for those Treasure Hoarders to walk into our trap.
What if the Knights of Favonius find out?
Well, your concerns do have merit. Our unorthodox methods, if discovered by the Knights, could land us in hot water...
But rest assured, that gentleman has guaranteed that no such trouble will occur. So let's just... have a little faith, shall we?
So, all you need to do is to wait till nightfall, and defeat our entrapped Treasure Hoarders.
What if the Treasure Hoarders don't show up?
Oh, they will, alright. Don't you worry about that. These plans were laid by that gentleman himself. Nothing will go wrong.
Taking care of this lot of brigands should encourage the rest to behave a little.

dialogs.text: Have those Treasure Hoarders been taken care of?
Very well taken care of, indeed.
Haha, I'd expect no less from someone who's caught that gentleman's eye. You're very efficient.
Here's your compensation. It was a... pleasure working with you.
If fortune permits, we'll have a chance to do business again.
